description: Store a suspected wrong closing for later review. Requires calendar, date, claim, and source_url. The report is not applied to either calendar. The result is accepted true and applied false. claim is one line of at most 500 characters. source_url is an http or https URL with no username or password. Do not send a name or an email. This is not a calculation.

calendar.description: Calendar id. Required. Unknown ids are an error.

claim.description: One line, at most 500 characters. Do not include a name or an email address.

date.description: Civil date, YYYY-MM-DD. Not a timestamp.

source_url.description: http or https URL for the source that was checked. No username or password.

name: report_discrepancy
title: Report a discrepancy
